line.name: Alfonso Extra Añejo
line.description: Marketed on unitedcigargroup.com simply as 'Alfonso Añejo'. Aged 5+ years, finished in French oak-lined rooms. 25 cigars/box. Produced by Selected Tobacco S.A. (also makers of Atabey and Byron), named after Nelson Alfonso Egüed. NOTE: trade press (Cigar Aficionado, Cigar Coop, halfwheel) documents this line as debuting in 2022 - we found no verified evidence of an older ('1979') Alfonso brand history; do not treat any pre-2022 backstory as confirmed.
line.origin_country: Not explicitly confirmed for this sub-line (Gran Selección below is confirmed Costa Rica)

research_notes: Also sold as 3-count tubes and in a giftpack with an ashtray accessory (photos exist but aren't separate cigar SKUs: 2-Tubes, 3-Tube, 4-Tubes, Giftpack-With-Cigar - not added as vitolas, see image manifest).
